name: Graphite Glass
inspiration: Apple-like smoked glass (macOS dark mode, visionOS) over live vertical talking-head footage. Approved from still mockups on the all-lang-tools reel, 2026-11-19.
summary: Clean, minimal, premium vertical-reel overlays: a top-left glass card, a top-right progress index, and sentence-case glass caption pills. Two modes: Graphite (dark glass) for light footage, Frost (white glass) for dark footage.

format.notes: Vertical-first. Footage stays full-frame; graphics inset 60px from the sides and at least 160px from the top.

split.use: leftbraincoder standard: white drifting-light canvas, graphics top, speaker card bottom

palette.notes: Graphite values shown; Frost overrides live in tokens.css under [data-mode=frost]. One accent only: blue = active, green = done, red = wrong.

fonts.notes: Weights 600-700, sentence case, -0.02em tracking on titles and captions.

motion: Calm and physical. Entrances blur-in + rise 16px + scale .98 over 0.6s expo.out; moves and morphs power2.inOut 0.45-0.5s; the tick is the only overshoot (back.out 1.4). Slow camera push 1.00-1.06 per section. Split layout: continuous 3D float on every panel, a -7deg Y turn plus a sheen on every item change, staggered blur-in children, and depth entrances and exits.
transitions: Card content cross-fades and blurs inside a panel that stays put. No hard cuts, whips, flashes, or bounces.
